title: The Domain of Validity of Cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization for Drug-Target Prioritization
description: Pre-registered evaluation of cis-pQTL Mendelian randomization as a predictor of Phase III trial success, across 143 drug-target-indication pairs spanning 91 genes and 24 diseases. Includes the corrected analysis, the full pre-registration chain V1-V7 with SHA-256 freeze records, an audit and correction of eight erroneous outcome-GWAS accessions, and the EpiGraphDB catalog files needed to regenerate 40 of the pairs. The classifier discriminates above chance (balanced accuracy 0.5783, 90% CI [0.5223, 0.6364]) with a positive predictive value of 0.588 against a base rate of 0.308. The registered prediction that performance differs by drug mechanism is not supported at this sample size (gene-clustered permutation p = 0.2144).
